senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (अडति)
To strive or endeavour.
5th cl. (अड्नोति)
To occupy or possess, (peculiar to the Vedas.)

r. 1st cl. (अड्डति)
1 To connect.
2 To solve, or demonstrate.
3 To strive, to endeavour. The radical penultimate is द, and the root is also written by VOPADEVA, अद्द.

m. (-रः)
1 Charge sounded by musical instruments.
2 The roaring of elephants.
3 A drum used in battle.
4 Commencement.
5 The eyelid.
6 Pride, arrogance.
7 Anger, passion.
8 Happiness, pleasure.
n. (-रं)
Rubbing and moulding the body.
E.
आङ्, दम to tame or subdue, बरच् affix; द is changed to ड.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Proud, arrogant.
E.
आडम्बर and इनि aff.
